documentation_basics_justification: Installation, first scans and verification are documented in https://github.com/stephrobert/pepin/blob/main/README.md and https://github.com/stephrobert/pepin/blob/main/docs/install.md . Safe use and security limitations are documented in https://github.com/stephrobert/pepin/blob/main/SECURITY.md .
documentation_interface_justification: The generated CLI reference documents verbs, flags and exit codes: https://github.com/stephrobert/pepin/blob/main/docs/reference/cli.md . Inputs and outputs are documented in https://github.com/stephrobert/pepin/blob/main/docs/reference/inventory.md and https://github.com/stephrobert/pepin/blob/main/docs/reference/output-formats.md . Tests check the reference against the compiled binary.
english_justification: English documentation is primary, with French counterparts. English bug reports and code comments are accepted through GitHub: https://github.com/stephrobert/pepin/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md .
release_notes_vulns_justification: No published GitHub security advisory exists for this project's own code. The Go standard-library advisories listed in v0.5.0 concern dependencies, which this criterion explicitly excludes. The release still documents those updates and the credential-projection fix: https://github.com/stephrobert/pepin/releases/tag/v0.5.0 .
report_responses_justification: No bug report was submitted by a third party in the last 12 months (0 issues); the tracker is open to everyone: https://github.com/stephrobert/pepin/issues
enhancement_responses_justification: No enhancement request was submitted by a third party in the last 12 months (0 issues); the tracker is open to everyone: https://github.com/stephrobert/pepin/issues
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: GitHub private vulnerability reporting is enabled. Reports are submitted privately over HTTPS at https://github.com/stephrobert/pepin/security/advisories/new ; instructions are in https://github.com/stephrobert/pepin/blob/main/SECURITY.md .
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: The maintainer confirms that no vulnerability report was received in the last six months, including through other private channels. The GitHub security-advisory API also reports no advisories. The criterion explicitly permits N/A in this case.
test_invocation_justification: The standard Go invocation is go test ./... . mise run test runs the Go suite with -race and the Rego suite: https://github.com/stephrobert/pepin/blob/main/mise.toml .
test_most_justification: The project does not yet claim comprehensive coverage of most code branches, input fields and functionality. No minimum Go coverage floor is enforced; control-scenario coverage is not Go branch coverage. This suggested criterion remains unmet until those dimensions are measured: https://github.com/stephrobert/pepin/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md .
test_policy_justification: Every new feature and behavior change must include automated tests in the same pull request; bug fixes must add regression tests. The policy covers successful and rejection paths: https://github.com/stephrobert/pepin/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#test-policy .
tests_are_added_justification: The v0.5.0 release integration added collector, assessment and policy-replay tests alongside functionality: https://github.com/stephrobert/pepin/commit/1458a4e50000c2a05146860164fe200a6206d0ca . The CI trust-policy changes added supply-chain regressions in the same change: https://github.com/stephrobert/pepin/commit/c8d561effd03887793bce333dbf31ec024f0a962 .
tests_documented_added_justification: The test policy is documented in the instructions for proposing changes, in English and French: https://github.com/stephrobert/pepin/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#test-policy and https://github.com/stephrobert/pepin/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.fr.md .
warnings_fixed_justification: The main ruleset requires golangci-lint and the audit check. Linter findings must be fixed or explicitly justified in configuration; tests have scoped gosec exclusions. See https://github.com/stephrobert/pepin/blob/main/.golangci.yml and https://github.com/stephrobert/pepin/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md .
warnings_strict_justification: The configuration explicitly enables errcheck, govet, ineffassign, staticcheck, unused, gosec, revive and unconvert, plus gofmt and goimports. It also documents why the English-only misspell checker is not practical for French source comments: https://github.com/stephrobert/pepin/blob/main/.golangci.yml .
know_secure_design_justification: The maintainer confirms that a primary developer knows secure-design principles, including the eight Saltzer and Schroeder principles, reducing attack surface and validating inputs with allowlists. Project applications and limits are documented at https://github.com/stephrobert/pepin/blob/main/SECURITY.md#security-design . This is a maintainer attestation, not a machine inference.
know_common_errors_justification: The maintainer confirms that a primary developer knows the relevant common security errors and at least one mitigation for each, including injection, authentication/authorization errors, credential disclosure, untrusted input and vulnerable dependencies. Project protections are documented at https://github.com/stephrobert/pepin/blob/main/SECURITY.md#common-errors-and-mitigations . This is a maintainer attestation.
crypto_published_justification: The project uses SHA-256, HMAC-SHA256, AWS Signature V4 and TLS, not a private cryptographic algorithm. The implementation calls Go standard-library primitives and the AWS signer: https://github.com/stephrobert/pepin/blob/main/internal/collect/auth.go and https://github.com/stephrobert/pepin/blob/main/internal/kubeauth/kubeauth.go .
crypto_call_justification: Hashing and MAC operations call crypto/sha256 and crypto/hmac. SigV4 calls the AWS SDK signer and TLS calls crypto/tls. EXO2 formats the signed request but does not reimplement HMAC or SHA-256: https://github.com/stephrobert/pepin/blob/main/internal/collect/auth.go .
crypto_floss_justification: The cryptographic implementations are FLOSS: Go standard library (BSD), AWS SDK for Go (Apache-2.0), and Cosign (Apache-2.0) for signatures. Dependencies and release tooling are documented in https://github.com/stephrobert/pepin/blob/main/go.mod and https://github.com/stephrobert/pepin/blob/main/.github/workflows/release.yml .
crypto_keylength_justification: TLS now enforces RSA >=2048 and EC >=224 bits for client certificates and verified server chains across Kubernetes, REST and S3; real local TLS tests reject RSA 1024 and accept RSA 2048/P-256. SHA-256 meets the digest-size requirement. The complete criterion remains Unmet: API-secret strength and signing-key scope have not yet been established. Credential length is not evidence of entropy. Scope and remaining limits: https://github.com/stephrobert/pepin/blob/main/SECURITY.md#cryptography .
crypto_working_justification: The project uses SHA-256 and HMAC-SHA256 and does not implement MD4, MD5, DES, RC4, ECB or its own cipher mode. The Kubernetes client requires TLS >=1.2 and uses Go's TLS implementation: https://github.com/stephrobert/pepin/blob/main/internal/collect/auth.go and https://github.com/stephrobert/pepin/blob/main/internal/kubeauth/kubeauth.go .
crypto_weaknesses_justification: The project's own digests and request MACs use SHA-256. The shared TLS policy permits only AEAD/ECDHE suites for TLS 1.2, excluding CBC/SHA-1 suites; TLS 1.3 is provided by Go. Upstream reachable vulnerabilities are checked in CI: https://github.com/stephrobert/pepin/blob/main/internal/tlspolicy/tlspolicy.go and https://github.com/stephrobert/pepin/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml .
crypto_pfs_justification: The common TLS policy requires TLS >=1.2 and explicitly permits only ECDHE suites for TLS 1.2; Go supplies TLS 1.3. This applies to Kubernetes, REST and S3: https://github.com/stephrobert/pepin/blob/main/internal/tlspolicy/tlspolicy.go . Request HMACs are authentication signatures, not a separate key-agreement protocol.
crypto_password_storage_justification: Pépin is a client-side scanner, not a password-authentication server. It has no database of external users' authentication passwords. Provider credentials are outbound credentials; the criterion explicitly excludes that case: https://github.com/stephrobert/pepin/blob/main/SECURITY.md#cryptography .
crypto_random_justification: TLS key generation and nonces are delegated to Go crypto/tls; the project does not set tls.Config.Rand or use math/rand for a security mechanism. It does not generate provider API credentials. Signature tooling uses Cosign's cryptographic implementation: https://github.com/stephrobert/pepin/blob/main/internal/kubeauth/kubeauth.go and https://github.com/stephrobert/pepin/blob/main/.github/workflows/release.yml .
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: The delivered scanner is Go, built with CGO_ENABLED=0, with no project C/C++ code, cgo import or unsafe import. Python, shell, Rego and Terraform files are tooling or policy, not a project implementation in a memory-unsafe language: https://github.com/stephrobert/pepin/blob/main/.github/workflows/release.yml .
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: Go tests and fuzz targets execute their assertions during testing. The inventory fuzz target checks rejection/error invariants, and weekly campaigns exercise it and the Terraform parser: https://github.com/stephrobert/pepin/blob/main/cmd/fuzz_test.go and https://github.com/stephrobert/pepin/blob/main/.github/workflows/campaigns.yml .
